name: High Wilderness
summary: The High Wilderness is an expansive, untamed stretch of primordial forest covering much of western Feralas. Bordered by the Verdantis River to the east and the Forgotten Coast to the west, it shelters a wide array of wildlife, wandering treants, and dangerous beasts beneath its towering emerald canopy.

sections.title: The Primordial Canopy
sections.body: Stretching across the western half of Feralas, the High Wilderness represents the quintessential untamed wilderness of southern Kalimdor. Thick foliage and colossal trees block out much of the sky, creating a lush expanse teeming with wolves, bears, hippogryphs, and yetis. Ancient treants wander among the roots, while aggressive ogre clans establish footholds in the shaded clearings. Navigating this vast green expanse requires vigilance, as the dense brush hides both natural predators and lingering primeval hazards.

faq.q: Where is the High Wilderness located?
faq.answer: The High Wilderness encompasses the vast forestlands of western Feralas. It lies west of the Verdantis River and extends all the way to the cliffs and shores bordering the Forgotten Coast.

faq.q: What creatures roam the High Wilderness?
faq.answer: The forest is home to dense populations of bears, wolves, hippogryphs, and feral yetis. In addition to natural beasts, travelers regularly encounter roaming treants and aggressive ogres lurking under the canopy.

faq.q: Are there gorillas in the High Wilderness?
faq.answer: While primates wander other regions of Feralas, the gorillas generally keep to the eastern parts of the zone, leaving the High Wilderness dominated by predators like wolves and bears.

angles.text: The ancient treants and vibrant wildlife of the High Wilderness showcase Kalimdor's natural primal strength, untouched by the civilization of the eastern lands.
Dense populations of fierce bears, wolves, and wild hippogryphs make the High Wilderness an exceptional proving ground for tracking and taming formidable beasts.
